title: 第3章 元炁背尸第4章 凑银两担道义
lines: “昨儿夜里又做那个怪梦了。”
天刚蒙蒙亮，小陆沉就已醒转过来。
打从那场大病之后，他脑袋里不仅莫名多出陌生记忆，还常常做同一个怪梦。
也不敢与外人讲，生怕被当成撞邪，沾染脏东西。
“这日子，倒是过得没那么紧了。
等再攒些钱，去庙里求个平安符……”
小陆沉闭眼想道。
昨日有了收获，得了一些钱财，又靠沈爷平了回春堂的账，近期不用急着再去进山。
只不过安宁县的庙宇，腰包里没个十几两银子，很难迈得过门槛。
“山海显圣……”
“好古怪的东西。”
小陆沉皱着眉。
他一边打水洗漱，一边思索那怪梦。
柳条蘸着牙粉，将自己洗漱干净。
脑海里那些陌生记忆，管这个叫“刷牙”
用清水抹了把小脸，小陆沉回到屋内。
沉下心啥都不去想，试图捕捉梦中显现的那方小印。
昨儿的梦境，比起之前都要真实，清晰。
让他产生这样的念头。
下一刻！
小陆沉的眉心，好像燃起一团火焰。
火势凶猛，愈来愈旺，烧得额头隐隐作痛。
小陆沉倒吸凉气，两只手赶忙按了上去，使劲揉搓，似要将那古怪的炽热感揉化开来。
却不曾想，这股炽热很快就变成一种让人难以忍受的滚烫。
仿佛有一柄尖锥，正从他脑袋里面往外穿刺！
痛！
太痛了！
强烈刺痛，几乎让小陆沉失声惨叫。
那颗小脑袋瓜，像被烧红的尖刀生生割成两半。
所幸有好几年做采药客的风霜打磨，小陆沉忍住煎熬，深深呼吸。
这是爷爷教他的法子。
叫做“导引”
旁的作用没有，只能强身健体。
多亏这法子，小陆沉才熬得住风吹日晒，跋涉深山的苦头。
“形神兼养，松静自然；起吸落呼，气血通畅……”
小陆沉嘴巴开合，低声喃喃。
content_en:
"I had that weird dream again last night."
As soon as the sky dawned, Xiao Luchen had already woken up.
Ever since that serious illness, he not only had strange memories in his head, but he also often had the same strange dream.
I dare not tell anyone about it, for fear of being regarded as evil and contaminated with dirty things.
“These days, life is not so tight.
When I save some money, I can go to the temple to ask for a peace charm..."
Xiao Luchen closed his eyes and thought.
There was a harvest yesterday, I got some money, and I relied on Master Shen to settle the accounts of Huichun Hall. There is no need to rush to the mountains again in the near future.
It's just that for temples in Anning County, it's difficult to pass the threshold if you don't have more than a dozen taels of silver in your pocket.
"Mountains and seas reveal their sages..."
"What a weird thing."
Xiao Luchen frowned.
As he fetched water and washed himself, he thought about the strange dream.
Willow dipped in tooth powder and washed himself clean.
Those strange memories in my mind, call this "brushing your teeth"
After wiping his face with water, Xiao Lu sank back into the house.
I calmed down and didn't think about anything, trying to capture the small seal that appeared in my dream.
Yesterday's dream was more real and clear than before.
Let him have such thoughts.
The next moment!
Xiao Lu Chen's eyebrows seemed to be lit with a ball of fire.
The fire was fierce and getting stronger, burning my forehead with a dull pain.
"Hiss!"
Xiao Luchen gasped, and quickly pressed it with both hands, rubbing it vigorously, as if to get rid of the strange burning feeling.
But he never thought that this blazing heat would soon turn into an unbearable boiling temperature.
It was as if a sharp awl was piercing out from the inside of his head!
pain!
It hurts so much!
The stinging pain was so strong that Xiao Lu Chen almost screamed.
That little head looked like it had been cut in half by a red-hot sharp knife.
Fortunately, after several years of experience as a herbal collector, Xiao Luchen endured the torment and took a deep breath.
This is what his grandfather taught him.
It's called "guidance"
It has no side effect, it can only strengthen the body.
Thanks to this method, Xiao Lu Chen was able to withstand the hardships of the wind, sun, and trekking into the mountains.
"Both body and soul are nourished, relaxed and quiet, natural; rising and falling inhalation and exhalation, qi and blood are smooth..."
Xiao Luchen opened and closed his mouth and murmured in a low voice.
